name: paladin_optimal
provenance: Hand-authored from build_paladin-hammerdin.md v11 §11 (ROTATION), the rotation as DESIGNED. Pairs with apl_paladin_observed.json, which models the rotation as PLAYED; the gap between the two is the value of the §11 rotation fix. ⚠ One button in §11 could not be resolved: the plain 'Judgement' has no card in the current pool (both CharacterAdvancement entries named 'Judgement' carry in_current_pool=0), so priority 3 of §11 is ABSENT from this APL rather than substituted with a guess. Its omission understates both APLs equally, so the COMPARISON between them stands, but neither absolute number includes it.

entries.comment: Lightbound Cleave: queued off-GCD at all times, macroed onto fillers (§11 priority 8). Warrior-tagged, feeds no Hammerdin procs, so it costs the engine nothing to queue.
Seal of Command up wire-to-wire (§11 priority 1)
Seal of Vengeance, paired with SoC via Twist of Faith (§11 priority 1)
Hour of Judgement on cooldown - the only burst window, and the whole reason the build exists (§11 priority 2)
Holy Shock on cooldown - Paladin-tagged, feeds Hammerdin's cooldown reduction. §11 names this one of the two single largest rotation errors.
Dawnreaver on its 4s cooldown - Paladin-tagged via Crusader Strike modifiers (§11 priority 5)
Judgement of The Three Hammers - wide-intake engine, fed by any direct damage
Whirling Light on its 10s cooldown (§11 priority 6)
Consecration - earns its slot per v5, 2.2-7.6% at 30-79% uptime
Holy Finish at 5 CP ONLY - the CP term is quadratic ((AP+SP) x CP^2 x 0.02), so 3->5 CP is ~2.8x, not 1.67x. Never dump below max (§11 priority 7).

Blades of Light ONLY while Hour of Judgement is unavailable (§11 priority 9). Its channel locks out every other ability and starves the Hammerdin engine, so using it near a HoJ window is actively negative.
